summary: Implementation plan for F-007 Sentiment Propagation, F-008 Capital Flow Divergence, F-009 Cross-Event Correlation. 5 tasks across 2 execution waves, creating 3 new modules + 3 test files with 24 total tests.
approach: Parallel implementation of F-007 and F-008 (independent features, separate files), followed by F-009 (depends on both). Each feature gets its own module file (sentiment.py, divergence.py, correlation.py) and test file. No existing files are modified -- all changes are additive. DAG property preserved by using single-direction edges for correlation.
